title: S.E.M. 8
subtitle: Strength. Endurance. MetCon.
purpose: Eight-week preparation for ATHX individual or pairs competition. The athlete completes the training as an individual; pair entrants share work only where the competition format allows.
tagline: STRONG ENOUGH TO LIFT HEAVY. FIT ENOUGH TO KEEP MOVING. PREPARED ENOUGH TO DO BOTH WHEN IT COUNTS.
independent_disclaimer: Produced independently by SEVEN3SEVEN. Not produced, approved or endorsed by ATHX.

weeks.title: Establish the standard
weeks.checkpoint: Record honest baselines, choose safe training loads and make every repetition legal.

sessions.title: Strict press baseline + upper-body balance
sessions.purpose: Establish a strong press marker and build the upper-back support needed for a better 1RM.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy SkiErg or row, band pull-aparts, shoulder circles and progressive empty-bar presses.

blocks.name: Strict press baseline
blocks.instruction: Work to 1 x 3 at RPE 8. Then complete 3 x 5 at 70-72% of current 1RM or RPE 7. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Upper pull
blocks.instruction: 4 x 8-10 ring rows, pull-ups or chest-supported rows at RPE 7.

blocks.name: Shoulder support
blocks.instruction: 3 x 12-15 lateral raises and 3 x 15-20 band pull-aparts.

blocks.name: Easy SkiErg
blocks.instruction: 8 min conversational pace.

sessions.coach_note: The top triple is a training marker, not a 3RM test. Stop if the bar path, lockout or body position changes.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Run-row repeatability baseline
sessions.purpose: Establish category-specific run and row splits without turning the first endurance session into a time trial.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy run and row, including three 20 sec relaxed pickups on each modality.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: Complete 3 rounds of your category distance on the run, immediately followed by the same distance on the rower. ATHX: 750m + 750m. Pro: 1km + 1km. Rest 2 min after each row. Work at RPE 7.5-8.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy walk and row until breathing is controlled.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Record every split, fastest-to-slowest drop-off and the time needed to settle after each transition.

sessions.coach_note: The three rounds should look alike. If Round 3 falls apart, Round 1 was too fast.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Back squat baseline + posterior-chain support
sessions.purpose: Establish a strong legal triple and build the positions that support a higher 3RM.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy row, ankles, hips, adductors and progressive squat sets.

blocks.name: Back squat baseline
blocks.instruction: Work to 1 x 3 at RPE 8. Then complete 3 x 3 at about 90% of that top set. Rest 3 min.

blocks.name: Romanian deadlift
blocks.instruction: 3 x 6 at RPE 7. Lower under control and keep a strong back position.

blocks.name: Single-leg support
blocks.instruction: 2 x 8 each leg reverse lunge or split squat at RPE 7.

blocks.name: Trunk
blocks.instruction: 3 x 30-40 sec heavy suitcase hold each side.

sessions.coach_note: Depth and full extension matter more than adding another plate. Leave two good reps available.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: MetCon repeatability EMOM
sessions.purpose: Build clean station work with enough rest to protect standards and repeatability.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy SkiErg plus light practice of ground-to-overhead, box, sandbag and lunge positions.

blocks.name: 24-min EMOM
blocks.instruction: Min 1: 10-12 cal SkiErg. Min 2: 6 ground-to-overhead at 60-70% of competition load. Min 3: 6-8 box jump overs at a safe training height. Min 4: 20m sandbag carry at 70-80% of competition load. Complete 6 rounds.

blocks.name: Easy flush
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy row or bike.

blocks.name: Trunk
blocks.instruction: 3 rounds: 30 sec side plank each side and 10 controlled dead bugs.

sessions.coach_note: Each minute should leave at least 12-15 seconds. Reduce work before movement quality drops.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Deadlift baseline + controlled work capacity
sessions.purpose: Establish repeatable five-rep strength and introduce fatigue-resistant race movement.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy machine, hamstrings, bracing and progressive deadlift sets.

blocks.name: Deadlift
blocks.instruction: 3 x 5 at RPE 7-7.5. Use a competition-legal stance and grip; no straps.

blocks.name: Upper-back support
blocks.instruction: 3 x 8 chest-supported row plus 3 x 30 sec dead hang.

blocks.name: 12-min AMRAP
blocks.instruction: 8 cal SkiErg, 10m walking lunge at 60-70% of competition load, 6 burpee broad jumps. Hold RPE 7.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: Easy spin or walk and record the score.

sessions.coach_note: Finish knowing you could have continued for several minutes. Week 1 rewards information, not exhaustion.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Optional Zone 2 + movement standards
sessions.purpose: Add aerobic work and practise event standards without interfering with the five core sessions.

blocks.name: Zone 2
blocks.instruction: 30-40 min easy bike, row, SkiErg or run at RPE 4-5.

blocks.name: Standards practice
blocks.instruction: Two easy rounds: 4 ground-to-overhead, 4 box jump overs, 10m carry, 6m lunge and 6m burpee broad jump. Use light loads and stop well before fatigue.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min shoulders, front rack, hips, calves and ankles.

sessions.coach_note: This session should improve how you feel. It is optional and does not count against programme completion.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

weeks.title: Add useful volume
weeks.checkpoint: Increase total quality work without turning volume into grinding or sloppy standards.

sessions.title: Strict press volume
sessions.purpose: Increase useful pressing volume while keeping one controlled heavy exposure.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy SkiErg, bands and progressive press sets.

blocks.name: Heavy exposure
blocks.instruction: 1 smooth single at RPE 8, around 85-88% of current 1RM.

blocks.name: Volume work
blocks.instruction: 4 x 4 at RPE 7-7.5. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Upper pull
blocks.instruction: 4 x 10 ring rows or chest-supported rows.

blocks.name: Shoulder control
blocks.instruction: 3 x 12-15 lateral raises and 3 x 15-20 band pull-aparts.

blocks.name: Easy SkiErg
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min conversational pace.

sessions.coach_note: The single should move cleanly. It is not a daily maximum.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: 500m row intervals
sessions.purpose: Build repeatable rowing power and comfort at a hard sustainable split.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy row including 3 x 10 hard strokes.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 8 x 500m at RPE 8 with 75 sec very easy rowing or complete rest.

blocks.name: Easy row
blocks.instruction: 10 min gradually reducing effort.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: Hips, lats and thoracic rotation.

sessions.coach_note: Aim to keep the fastest and slowest repetitions within 2-3 seconds.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Back squat volume
sessions.purpose: Build squat volume that supports a stronger triple later in the programme.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min row, hips, ankles and progressive squat sets.

blocks.name: Back squat
blocks.instruction: 4 x 4 at RPE 7.5. Rest 3 min.

blocks.name: Paused back squat
blocks.instruction: 2 x 3 at RPE 7 with a clear 2 sec pause.

blocks.name: Bulgarian split squat
blocks.instruction: 3 x 8 each leg at a controlled load.

blocks.name: Core
blocks.instruction: 2 x 40 sec heavy suitcase hold each side.

sessions.coach_note: Do not turn the paused squats into a grind. The pause is for position and control.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: 18-minute mixed AMRAP
sessions.purpose: Practise self-pacing and smooth transitions across the event movement patterns.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min jog, row and movement rehearsal at light load.

blocks.name: 18-min AMRAP
blocks.instruction: 400m run, 8 ground-to-overhead at 75-85% of competition load, 12 box jump overs at a safe race-relevant height, 20m sandbag carry at 75-85% load and 10m burpee broad jumps.

blocks.name: Easy recovery
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min walk or spin.

blocks.name: Shoulder care
blocks.instruction: 3 x 15 band pull-aparts and 3 x 12 face pulls.

sessions.coach_note: Choose a first-round pace you could hold for 25 minutes. The final three minutes may be hard; the first three should not be.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Deadlift build + repeatable rounds
sessions.purpose: Increase five-rep strength and practise short repeatable MetCon efforts.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy row and progressive deadlift sets.

blocks.name: Deadlift
blocks.instruction: 4 x 5 at RPE 7.5-8. Rest 3 min and reset the brace before every rep.

blocks.name: Repeatable rounds
blocks.instruction: 5 rounds, not for time: 12 cal SkiErg, 10m lunge at 70-80% of competition load, 10m burpee broad jumps, then rest 60 sec.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: Easy walk and breathing.

sessions.coach_note: Keep every round within roughly five seconds of the others. This is repeatability, not a race.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Optional Zone 2 + GTOH efficiency
sessions.purpose: Build aerobic volume and make the ground-to-overhead movement cheaper.

blocks.name: Ground-to-overhead skill
blocks.instruction: Every 90 sec x 8: 4-6 technically clean reps. Begin at 60% of competition load and progress only if lockout and control remain perfect.

blocks.name: Zone 2
blocks.instruction: 30-35 min easy bike, row or SkiErg.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: Shoulders, lats, hips and ankles.

sessions.coach_note: The skill work should never become a hidden MetCon.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

weeks.title: Heavier work and first rehearsal
weeks.checkpoint: The full strength sequence is rehearsed below maximum. Learn the clock, order and standards without chasing failure.

sessions.title: Heavy strict press + pull strength
sessions.purpose: Move a heavier single, then build force with quality triples.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy SkiErg, bands and progressive press sets.

blocks.name: Strict press single
blocks.instruction: 1 single at RPE 8.5, approximately 90-92%.

blocks.name: Strict press triples
blocks.instruction: 5 x 3 at RPE 8. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Weighted pull-up
blocks.instruction: 4 x 5, or strict ring rows if needed.

blocks.name: Ski intervals
blocks.instruction: 8 rounds of 30 sec strong / 30 sec easy.

blocks.name: Shoulder care
blocks.instruction: 2 x 15 face pulls and 2 x 20 band pull-aparts.

sessions.coach_note: Only take the planned single if warm-ups are crisp. A slightly lighter clean rep wins.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: 1km run repeats
sessions.purpose: Improve running pace and control near 5-10km intensity.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12 min easy jog plus 3 x 20 sec strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 5 x 1km at current 5km pace to 10 sec/km slower, with 90 sec easy jog after each. Cap at RPE 8.5.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy jog.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: Calves, hips and hamstrings.

sessions.coach_note: Hold the same pace across all five. Do not chase a heroic first kilometre.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Heavy back squat triple
sessions.purpose: Move toward a stronger 3RM without taking a true maximum.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12 min row, lower-body mobility and progressive squat sets.

blocks.name: Top triple
blocks.instruction: Work to 1 x 3 at RPE 8.5.

blocks.name: Back-off squat
blocks.instruction: 3 x 3 at approximately 90% of the top set.

blocks.name: Lower support
blocks.instruction: Hamstring curl 3 x 10 and calf raise 3 x 15.

blocks.name: Easy flush
blocks.instruction: 7-10 min bike or walk.

sessions.coach_note: Depth and full extension are non-negotiable. A shallow PR is still a poor rep.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Four rounds for time
sessions.purpose: Practise transitions and hold movement standards as fatigue rises.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min row and movement rehearsal.

blocks.name: 4 rounds for time
blocks.instruction: 500m row, 10 ground-to-overhead at 80-90% of competition load, 10 box jump overs at race height where safe, 20m sandbag carry at competition load. 24-min cap.

blocks.name: Easy recovery
blocks.instruction: 10 min walk or cycle.

blocks.name: Trunk
blocks.instruction: 3 x 10 hanging knee raises and 3 x 30 sec side plank.

sessions.coach_note: Use race height only when every rep is safe and clean. Step down to protect the Achilles and calves.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Sub-maximal 20-minute strength sequence
sessions.purpose: Rehearse the exact lift order, time windows and loading decisions without maximal attempts.

blocks.name: Full warm-up
blocks.instruction: 20-22 min. Prepare strict press, back squat and deadlift. Set out plates before the clock starts.

blocks.name: 0-6 min strict press
blocks.instruction: Complete up to three successful singles around 70%, 82% and 88-90% of current 1RM.

blocks.name: 6-12 min back squat
blocks.instruction: Complete up to three successful triples around 70%, 82% and 88-90%.

blocks.name: 12-20 min deadlift
blocks.instruction: Complete up to three successful fives around 70%, 80% and 85-87%.

blocks.name: Easy row
blocks.instruction: 15 min conversational pace.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Record successful loads, loading time and any movement-standard risks.

sessions.coach_note: Leave weight in reserve. This session exists to expose poor decisions before race week.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Optional Zone 2 + lunge and burpee skill
sessions.purpose: Maintain aerobic volume and improve lower-body station efficiency at low fatigue.

blocks.name: Zone 2
blocks.instruction: 30-35 min easy bike or SkiErg at RPE 4-5.

blocks.name: Lunge skill
blocks.instruction: 4 x 10m at 50-60% competition load. Practise legal knee contact and full extension.

blocks.name: Burpee broad jump skill
blocks.instruction: 4 x 6-8m at easy rhythm. Practise legal hand and foot positions.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: Calves, hips and front rack.

sessions.coach_note: This is technique and rhythm, not another hard conditioning day.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

weeks.title: Reduce fatigue and absorb the work
weeks.checkpoint: Finish this week feeling better than you started it. Freshness is the target, not a bonus workout.

sessions.title: Light strict press + easy upper body
sessions.purpose: Keep the press familiar while allowing fatigue to fall.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy SkiErg and bands.

blocks.name: Strict press
blocks.instruction: 3 x 5 at RPE 6.

blocks.name: Easy upper pull
blocks.instruction: 3 x 12 ring rows and 2 x 15 lateral raises.

blocks.name: Zone 2 SkiErg
blocks.instruction: 15 min easy.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: Shoulders and upper back.

sessions.coach_note: Every rep should be smooth. Do not add sets because you feel fresh.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Easy mixed aerobic
sessions.purpose: Maintain the run and row patterns without adding meaningful fatigue.

blocks.name: Zone 2
blocks.instruction: Alternate 10 min easy run and 10 min easy row for 40 min total. Keep conversation possible.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: 5-8 min calves, hips and lats.

sessions.coach_note: Use the easiest available pace. The aim is circulation, not a score.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Light squat + lower-body restoration
sessions.purpose: Maintain squat skill and lower-body capacity with low stress.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy row and mobility.

blocks.name: Back squat
blocks.instruction: 3 x 5 at RPE 6.

blocks.name: Romanian deadlift
blocks.instruction: 2 x 6 at RPE 6.

blocks.name: Step-up
blocks.instruction: 2 x 8 each leg, easy-moderate.

blocks.name: Easy bike
blocks.instruction: 10 min conversational.

sessions.coach_note: Nothing should grind and nothing should create soreness lasting more than a day.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Low-fatigue movement EMOM
sessions.purpose: Keep station rhythm and standards while reducing total stress.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy machine and movement rehearsal.

blocks.name: 16-min EMOM
blocks.instruction: Min 1: 8 cal machine. Min 2: 5 light ground-to-overhead. Min 3: 6 step overs. Min 4: 20m light carry. Complete 4 rounds.

sessions.coach_note: Every minute should leave at least 20 seconds. There is no score to chase.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Light deadlift + easy station flow
sessions.purpose: Maintain pulling skill and competition movement familiarity at low cost.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy machine and progressive deadlift sets.

blocks.name: Deadlift
blocks.instruction: 3 x 4 at RPE 6.

blocks.name: Three easy rounds
blocks.instruction: 5 ground-to-overhead, 5 box step overs, 10m sandbag carry, 6m lunge and 6m burpee broad jump. Rest as needed.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: Easy walk and mobility.

sessions.coach_note: Every movement should meet the competition standard. Finish fresher than you started.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Optional recovery + mobility
sessions.purpose: Support recovery without adding training stress.

blocks.name: Easy aerobic
blocks.instruction: 20-30 min very easy bike, swim, walk or row.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min hips, ankles, lats, shoulders and thoracic rotation.

sessions.coach_note: Skip this session when complete rest is the better choice.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

weeks.title: Competition loads and longer efforts
weeks.checkpoint: Competition loads become more common, but full race volume remains reserved for the rehearsal week.

sessions.title: Heavy strict press doubles
sessions.purpose: Increase confidence near competition intensity while keeping enough back-off volume.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy SkiErg, bands and progressive press sets.

blocks.name: Heavy doubles
blocks.instruction: 3 x 2 at RPE 8.5, roughly 87-90%.

blocks.name: Back-off triples
blocks.instruction: 3 x 3 at RPE 8.

blocks.name: Upper pull
blocks.instruction: 4 x 6 strict pull-ups or a heavy row.

blocks.name: Shoulder control
blocks.instruction: 3 x 20 band pull-aparts and 3 x 20-35 sec handstand or pike hold.

blocks.name: Easy SkiErg
blocks.instruction: 8 min relaxed pace.

sessions.coach_note: If the second rep becomes a grind, reduce the final set.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Category-distance run-row intervals
sessions.purpose: Build the ability to change modality and settle immediately into a strong event pace.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy run and row.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 3 rounds: category run distance immediately followed by category row distance, then 2 min easy rest. ATHX: 750m + 750m. Pro: 1km + 1km. Work at RPE 8 and keep all rounds even.

blocks.name: Easy recovery
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min walk and light row.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: Calves, hips and lats.

sessions.coach_note: This is not the full 22-minute rehearsal. Use a hard but repeatable pace.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Competition-style squat triple
sessions.purpose: Move a near-target legal triple and confirm likely race-day loading.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12-15 min full squat preparation and progressive sets.

blocks.name: Top triple
blocks.instruction: 1 x 3 at RPE 8.5-9.

blocks.name: Back-off squat
blocks.instruction: 2 x 3 at approximately 90% of the top set.

blocks.name: Paused squat
blocks.instruction: 2 x 3 at RPE 7 with a 2 sec pause.

blocks.name: Lower support
blocks.instruction: 2 x 10 hamstring curl and 2 x 15 calf raise.

sessions.coach_note: The top triple must be legal and repeatable. Save a true 3RM for rehearsal or competition.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Three mixed seven-minute intervals
sessions.purpose: Produce strong repeated blocks with full control of pace and movement standards.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min and rehearse each movement.

blocks.name: Block 1 - 7 min
blocks.instruction: Repeat: 10-12 cal SkiErg, 5-6 ground-to-overhead at 85-100% competition load and 8 box jump overs.

blocks.name: Recovery
blocks.instruction: 3 min walk and breathe.

blocks.name: Block 2 - 7 min
blocks.instruction: Repeat: 12 cal row, 10m competition-style lunge and 6-8m burpee broad jump.

blocks.name: Recovery
blocks.instruction: 3 min walk and breathe.

blocks.name: Block 3 - 7 min
blocks.instruction: Repeat: 200m run, 20m sandbag carry at competition load and 6 burpees.

blocks.name: Easy flush
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min bike or row.

sessions.coach_note: Use full competition load only where clean movement can be maintained for the entire block.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Heavy deadlift five + partial race work
sessions.purpose: Confirm a strong five-rep set, then practise competition movements at limited volume.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12-14 min easy row and progressive deadlift sets.

blocks.name: Top five
blocks.instruction: 1 x 5 at RPE 8.5, then 2 x 4 at approximately 90% of the top set.

blocks.name: Partial MetCon - 2 rounds for time
blocks.instruction: 15 cal SkiErg, 8 ground-to-overhead at competition load, 10 box jump overs at race height and 10m competition-style lunge. 18-min cap.

blocks.name: Easy recovery
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min walk or spin.

sessions.coach_note: The heavy five must remain legal. No hitching contest, no straps and no emotional loading.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Optional Zone 2 + carry skill
sessions.purpose: Build aerobic capacity and improve sandbag efficiency without compromising Saturday.

blocks.name: Zone 2
blocks.instruction: 30-35 min easy bike, row or SkiErg.

blocks.name: Sandbag skill
blocks.instruction: 4 x 20m at 70-80% competition load. Practise the pickup, turn and finish line. Full recovery.

blocks.name: Box skill
blocks.instruction: 3 x 6 easy race-height reps if safe, stepping down every rep.

sessions.coach_note: This is a skill session. Stop before grip, back or landing quality falls.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.

weeks.title: Rehearse what will be scored
weeks.checkpoint: This is the most race-specific week. The goal is information and confidence, not fatigue that survives into Week 7.

sessions.title: Strict press maintenance
sessions.purpose: Keep pressing strength while saving freshness for the rehearsals.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy SkiErg, bands and progressive sets.

blocks.name: Strict press
blocks.instruction: 3 x 2 at RPE 8, then 2 x 3 at RPE 7.

blocks.name: Upper pull
blocks.instruction: 3 x 8-10 ring rows and 2 x 15 face pulls.

blocks.name: Easy SkiErg
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min conversational.

sessions.coach_note: No grind. The work is deliberately low volume.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Full 22-minute run-row rehearsal
sessions.purpose: Rehearse the exact individual endurance format and set race pacing.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12-15 min easy run and row with brief race-pace pickups.

blocks.name: 22-min rehearsal
blocks.instruction: Start on the run. Complete your category distance, then the same distance on the rower, repeating until 22 min expires. ATHX: 750m swaps. Pro: 1km swaps. Record total run and row metres.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy walk and row.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Set target opening pace, row split and transition routine.

sessions.coach_note: Run this as an individual. Pair entrants can share the competition workload later, but each athlete still needs their own engine.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Low-volume back squat
sessions.purpose: Keep heavy squat exposure without adding soreness before the final strength rehearsal.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12-14 min full squat preparation.

blocks.name: Back squat
blocks.instruction: 3 x 2 at RPE 8.

blocks.name: Back-off squat
blocks.instruction: 2 x 3 at RPE 7.

blocks.name: Easy single-leg work
blocks.instruction: 2 x 8 reverse lunges each leg.

sessions.coach_note: No leg finisher this week.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: 70% MetCon X rehearsal
sessions.purpose: Rehearse every station at competition load while limiting total volume.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12 min easy machine and all movement standards.

blocks.name: Rehearsal
blocks.instruction: Men: 30 cal SkiErg, 20 ground-to-overhead, 20m sandbag carry, 20 box jump overs, 20m walking lunge, 20m burpee broad jumps, 30 cal SkiErg. Women: use 20 cal SkiErg at each end. Use exact category loads and standards. 22-min cap.

blocks.name: Recovery
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy walk or bike.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Record every station split, planned breaks and the limiting station.

sessions.coach_note: Do not extend the volume to prove a point. This rehearsal exists to set pacing and expose standards.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: Final full strength rehearsal
sessions.purpose: Use the exact 20-minute format to set race-day attempts and loading strategy.

blocks.name: Full warm-up
blocks.instruction: 20-25 min. Prepare all three lifts and set the rack and plates exactly as planned.

blocks.name: 0-6 min strict press
blocks.instruction: Up to three successful singles. Suggested pattern: safe opener, highly likely second, earned third.

blocks.name: 6-12 min back squat
blocks.instruction: Up to three successful triples using the same attempt logic.

blocks.name: 12-20 min deadlift
blocks.instruction: Up to three successful sets of five. Stop if legal reps or speed deteriorate.

blocks.name: Easy row
blocks.instruction: 10 min conversational.

blocks.name: Decision sheet
blocks.instruction: Lock opening attempts, likely second attempts and third-attempt rules.

sessions.coach_note: No fourth attempts and no emotional loading. The best plan is the one you can execute under pressure.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

blocks.instruction: Write Saturday's exact rack, plate and attempt plan.

weeks.title: Keep speed, lose fatigue
weeks.checkpoint: Keep the nervous system sharp while reducing total work. Nothing should create soreness lasting more than 24 hours.

blocks.name: Strict press
blocks.instruction: 3 x 1 at RPE 8-8.5, then 2 x 3 at RPE 6-7.

blocks.name: Upper pull
blocks.instruction: 3 x 8 ring rows and 2 x 15 band pull-aparts.

blocks.name: Easy SkiErg
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min conversational.

blocks.name: Mobility

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy run and row.

blocks.name: Main set

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy movement.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: Calves, hips and lats.

sessions.coach_note: Finish fast but controlled. The fifth round should be the best, not the first.

sessions.title: 16-minute competition-load EMOM
sessions.purpose: Touch key race movements at full load with plenty of rest and perfect standards.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min and rehearse each movement.

blocks.name: 16-min EMOM
blocks.instruction: Min 1: 8-10 cal SkiErg. Min 2: 4-6 ground-to-overhead at competition load. Min 3: 6 box jump overs at race height. Min 4: 15-20m sandbag carry at competition load. Complete 4 rounds.

blocks.name: Easy recovery
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min walk or bike.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: Shoulders, hips and calves.

blocks.instruction: 8 min easy machine and mobility.

blocks.name: Three easy rounds
blocks.instruction: 5 cal SkiErg, 3 light ground-to-overhead, 4 box jump overs, 10m sandbag carry, 6m walking lunge and 6m burpee broad jump. Rest 90 sec.

blocks.instruction: 10 min easy walking and breathing.

sessions.title: Competition primer + equipment check
sessions.purpose: Leave the body switched on and remove race-day uncertainty.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 6-8 min easy machine.

blocks.name: Two easy rounds
blocks.instruction: 4 cal SkiErg, 2 ground-to-overhead, 3 box jump overs, 10m carry, 4m lunge and 4m burpee broad jump. Rest 2 min.

blocks.name: Equipment check
blocks.instruction: Confirm shoes, belt, sleeves, wraps, chalk, travel, food and opening attempts.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: Walk and breathe until fully relaxed.

sessions.coach_note: No added work. The primer is finished as soon as you feel sharp.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load or pace range. Remove one accessory set if needed.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce the main strength load by 5-7.5%, remove one back-off set, and reduce conditioning volume by about 20%.

sessions.title: ATHX performance
sessions.purpose: Produce three high-quality performances: strength, endurance and MetCon X.

blocks.name: Warm-up zone
blocks.instruction: Raise body temperature, prepare all three lifts and rehearse only enough race movement to feel ready.

blocks.name: Strength zone
blocks.instruction: Execute the pre-selected opener, likely second and earned third attempts for strict press, back squat and deadlift.

blocks.name: Endurance zone
blocks.instruction: Start on the run and alternate category distance between run and row for 22 minutes. Follow the pacing plan.

blocks.name: MetCon X zone
blocks.instruction: Execute the official category workout and planned station strategy.

blocks.name: Post-event review
blocks.instruction: Record results while details are fresh and identify the next training priority.

sessions.coach_note: Race the plan, not the adrenaline. Legal reps and controlled openings create the chance to finish hard.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use conservative opening attempts and controlled first station pace.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Do not improvise. Keep the safest successful strength plan and prioritise legal movement.

sessions.recommended_day: Three or one days before race
